data.long_meaning: From the Greek word gilastē, meaning 'pledged one' or 'promise'. In Greek mythology, Gilman was a name for a warrior or hero who had made a solemn vow or pledge to a god or cause. The name Gilman carries the meaning “Pledge, Pledged One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gilman usually hope their child will grow to embody pledge, pledged one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gilman total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
